missing_information: Whether overtime is material, and at what premium rates it is paid.
How overtime hours are recorded - self-reported timesheets or independent clocking.
Who approves overtime and whether approval is independent of the claimant.
then.note: A missing approval is a control deficiency, not proof the overtime was not worked. Unapproved claims require heavier substantive vouching, not automatic disallowance.

name: Overtime not independently approved -> inflated overtime risk
rationale: Without independent approval there is no check that overtime was worked or necessary, particularly where hours are self-reported. The rule directs vouching of overtime to approved timesheets corroborated by attendance records, plus analytical procedures to find concentrations.
source_reference: Professional practice guidance; standards references unverified - see docs/REFERENCES.md
